title: Children's Museum of Houston

services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Join our Education Team for action-packed, hands-on programs in science and technology, history and culture, health and human development, math, literacy in person or online.For group field trip transportation, consider booking a Houston charter bus from companies like GOGO Charters, Longhorn Charter Bus Houston, or National Charter Bus, which provide options for any-size bus rental in Houston or throughout the U.S. We believe learning outside of school supports learning in the classroom, and vice versa. All our exhibits and programs are aligned with the Texas Essential Knowledge and Skills (TEKS). Visiting children can apply what they have learned in school and gain Tips to prepare them

services.desc: FLIPSponsored by Samuels Family FoundationFLIP is a multilingual program for children birth to 8 years that pairs a family-centered activity kit with a book to instill a love of reading and learning. FLIP kits are available in the Parent Resource Library.Learn

services.name: Party package
services.desc: Celebrate your child's special day in a unique and meaningful way at Children's Museum Houston! Our birthday parties are thoughtfully designed to spark creativity, curiosity, and joy in every child. Through hands-on exhibits, interactive activities, and delightful surprises, we turn birthdays into unforgettable adventures that kids (and parents) will love.We've partnered with Evite to make planning your celebration even easier. After booking, you'll get access to exclusive, customizable digital invitations-perfect for getting guests exciting before the big day! Whether it's your child's first museum birthday or a returning tradition, our team is here to help you make it extra special.
